annotations.title: Check if AI assistants can read a website

description: Checks one public web page the way AI crawlers do: reads its robots.txt, meta robots / X-Robots-Tag, JSON-LD structured data and /llms.txt, and what a bot without JavaScript sees (text, prices, contact details), and reports, for each AI and search crawler (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Microsoft), whether it is allowed to read that page. Use when someone asks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Google AI can see, read or cite their site. Facts only, no score.

url.description: The page to check, e.g. example.co.il or https://example.com/services

name: check_ai_crawler_access
title: Check if AI assistants can read a website
